//: The e2e harness type-checks separately from the app.
The app's own `tsc --noEmit` is a release gate and its `types` list is
deliberately `['jest']` — no Node globals, because nothing that ships may
reach for one. The harness is Node tooling and needs them, so it gets its
own config and `tsconfig.json` excludes `e2e/`. The shipping gate is then
exactly what it was before this directory existed.
`e2e/server/` is excluded here as well, and only because of what it imports:
under their own configs with Node lib settings. Pulling that graph through a
React Native lib set reports errors in `packages/storage` — a lane this one
may not edit, about code this round never touched. The boot script is
verified by running it, which is the only way its database work could be
